# Booki

> Pick-tracking and bankroll management software for private groups. Not a sportsbook. Not pay-per-head. We never touch the money.

Booki (https://bookisports.com/) is a ledger: live odds, automated grading, credit limits, settlement reconciliation. Brand line: Be The House.

- Free: 3 members
- Pro: $49.99/month, cap 50 members
- No casino, racebook, call center, or branded sportsbook website
- No deposits, payouts, or payment processing
- If you need those, stay on PPH

## For people switching off pay-per-head

- [PPH software alternative](https://bookisports.com/pph-software-alternative): flat $49.99 vs per-head billing. Honest qualifier. Cost calculator (default 20 players × $7 ≈ $607/month).
- [Pay-per-head pricing breakdown](https://bookisports.com/blog/pay-per-head-pricing-breakdown): published August 2026 vendor rates at 10 / 20 / 50 players.
